description: The same typing burst against the 100,000-line, 10 MiB variant that the Phase 1 exit gate names. The extra width is trailing whitespace, so the span count is unchanged and the difference from typing-burst isolates one variable: what a four-times-larger document costs per keystroke. It is the trace that shows whether snapshot cost scales with document size.
budget: input-to-present at the Phase 1 fixture size
